rationale: Grady brings deep expertise in FDA-regulated AI medical devices and commercializing into government healthcare markets (VA, DoD), while Sharon's company builds production-ready AI agent infrastructure for industries where accuracy is critical—including healthtech. Their complementary skills could explore how agentic AI systems might enhance digital therapeutics platforms or streamline the regulatory and deployment workflows that Grady has navigated at scale.
intro_message: Grady Hannah, meet Sharon — she's building production-ready AI agent infrastructure at TheAgentic.Ai with focus on healthtech, and your FDA regulatory and commercialization playbook could be valuable as they think through how agents integrate into regulated medical workflows.
